name: fu-stats
js: (() => {const a=window.__CITY_APP,C=window.CITY,DV=C.DON_VALLEY; if(!DV) return {pilot:false, patios:C.patioStats&&C.patioStats.fingerprint}; const D=DV.data; return {pilot:true, patios:C.patioStats&&C.patioStats.fingerprint, box:D.box, ramps:D.alterations.ramps, river:D.alterations.river, reviews:D.diagnostics.roads.filter(r=>r.review), stats:C.donValleyStats?{plinths:C.donValleyStats.plinths,ms:Math.round(C.donValleyStats.ms)}:null}; })()

name: fu-teleport-viaduct
js: (() => {const a=window.__CITY_APP,cm=a.controllerManager,p=cm.getActiveEntity().position,d=window.CITY.DON_VALLEY?window.CITY.DON_VALLEY.deckTop:null; if(d!==null&&Math.abs(p.y-d)>0.05) throw new Error('A teleport onto the viaduct landed at '+p.y+' (deck '+d+')'); return {player:{x:p.x,y:p.y,z:p.z},deck:d,floorUnder:window.CITY.cutAt(p.x,p.z)};})()

name: fu-search-viaduct-car
js: (() => {const a=window.__CITY_APP,cm=a.controllerManager; a.tourGuide.teleportToPlace({kind:'spot',name:'On the viaduct',x:2330,z:-2806}); a.selectCamera('chase',true); const p=cm.getActiveEntity().position,d=window.CITY.DON_VALLEY?window.CITY.DON_VALLEY.deckTop:null; if(d!==null&&Math.abs(p.y-d)>0.05) throw new Error('A map/search arrival on the viaduct landed at '+p.y); return {player:{x:p.x,y:p.y,z:p.z},deck:d};})()

name: fu-search-valley
js: (() => {const a=window.__CITY_APP,cm=a.controllerManager,C=window.CITY; a.tourGuide.teleportToPlace({kind:'spot',name:'In the valley',x:2190,z:-2600}); a.selectCamera('chase',true); const p=cm.getActiveEntity().position; if(C.DON_VALLEY&&p.y>-25) throw new Error('A search arrival in the valley landed at '+p.y); return {player:{x:p.x,y:p.y,z:p.z},cutAt:C.cutAt(p.x,p.z)};})()

name: fu-rosedale-deck
js: (() => {const a=window.__CITY_APP,cm=a.controllerManager,C=window.CITY,p=cm.getActiveEntity().position,d=C.DON_VALLEY?C.DON_VALLEY.deckTop:null; if(d!==null&&Math.abs(p.y-d)>0.05) throw new Error('A teleport onto the Rosedale section landed at '+p.y); return {player:{x:p.x,y:p.y,z:p.z},ravineUnder:C.cutAt(p.x,p.z)};})()

name: fu-traffic-slope-check
js: (() => {const a=window.__CITY_APP,C=window.CITY,DV=C.DON_VALLEY,t=a.trafficSystem; const near=(o)=>DV&&DV.inBox(o.x,o.z)&&C.cutAt(o.x,o.z)<-1; const surf=(x,z,y)=>{const g=C.cutAt(x,z),d=C.deckHeightAt(x,z,y+1,2.5);return d!==0&&Math.abs(d-y)<Math.abs(g-y)?d:g;}; const cars=t.cars.filter(v=>Number.isFinite(v.x)&&Number.isFinite(v.y)&&near(v)).map(v=>({x:+v.x.toFixed(1),z:+v.z.toFixed(1),d:+Math.abs(v.y-surf(v.x,v.z,v.y)).toFixed(3)})).sort((p,q)=>q.d-p.d); const feet=t.peds.filter(p=>p.rig&&near(p)).flatMap(p=>p.rig.feet.map(f=>+Math.min(Math.abs(f.py-C.cutAt(f.px,f.pz)),Math.abs(f.py-C.cutAt(f.px,f.pz)-0.22),Math.abs(f.py-C.cutAt(f.px,f.pz)-0.012)).toFixed(3))); return {cars:cars.length,carWorst:cars.slice(0,3),feet:feet.length,footWorst:feet.length?Math.max(...feet):null};})()

name: fu-walkers-slope-check
js: (() => {const a=window.__CITY_APP,C=window.CITY,DV=C.DON_VALLEY,t=a.trafficSystem; const near=(o)=>DV&&DV.inBox(o.x,o.z)&&C.cutAt(o.x,o.z)<-1; const surf=(x,z,y)=>{const g=C.cutAt(x,z),d=C.deckHeightAt(x,z,y+1,2.5);return d!==0&&Math.abs(d-y)<Math.abs(g-y)?d:g;}; const cars=t.cars.filter(v=>Number.isFinite(v.x)&&Number.isFinite(v.y)&&near(v)).map(v=>({x:+v.x.toFixed(1),z:+v.z.toFixed(1),d:+Math.abs(v.y-surf(v.x,v.z,v.y)).toFixed(3)})).sort((p,q)=>q.d-p.d); const feet=t.peds.filter(p=>p.rig&&near(p)).flatMap(p=>p.rig.feet.map(f=>+Math.min(Math.abs(f.py-C.cutAt(f.px,f.pz)),Math.abs(f.py-C.cutAt(f.px,f.pz)-0.22),Math.abs(f.py-C.cutAt(f.px,f.pz)-0.012)).toFixed(3))); return {cars:cars.length,carWorst:cars.slice(0,3),feet:feet.length,footWorst:feet.length?Math.max(...feet):null};})()
